stories.title: Run weekly Primal Dad check-in
stories.description: Execute the Sunday weekly check-in flow for the Primal Dad recomp tracker. Walks Gab through the 4 dimensions (STR, CON, FLX, NUT), reads quest progress and lift log, ingests Garmin exports, runs the calorie adjustment loop, calculates XP with streak multipliers and weekly caps, updates all computed state files, unlocks any new achievements, and delivers a verbal summary with week-over-week comparison.
acceptance: Read data/computed/current-stats.json, active-quests.json, achievements.json to load current state
Read data/program/lift-log.json and nutrition-log.json for the week's entries
Check data/watch-imports/ for new Garmin CSV exports and parse if present (sleep, RHR, Zone 2)
Determine current ISO week and program week (1-12)
Walk Gab through the 4 dimensions conversationally — quests first if active
Calculate XP earned per dimension, respecting weekly caps (STR:80, CON:70, FLX:60, NUT:70)
Run calorie adjustment loop: compare week avg to 2,200 target + weight trend, recommend +/- 100 kcal
Check for level-ups and achievement unlocks
Write weekly history file to data/history/YYYY-WXX.json
Update index.html with new inline STATS object
If program_week == 6: run Week 6 milestone review (body measurements, lift trends, nutrition adherence)
If program_week == 12: run program summary + path-pick prompt
Deliver verbal summary: overall level/title, level-ups, streak, weakest dim, biggest win, calorie call, next-week focus
